xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi: Note 1 - Karan Bhagat (KB) & his PAC which includes Shilpa Bhagat; Kyra Family Private Trust; Kush Family Private Trust; Kyrush Investments forms part of KB Group has not created any pledge/lien on shares held by them in TC in favour of APAC Company XV Limited (APAC) & APAC doesnt have any right/title/interest in shares held by KB Group and/or any right to invoke the encumbrance in any manner to acquire shares held by KB Group. Pursuant to retention and profit sharing agreement dated 31-10-22 (RPSA) between APAC, KB & Yatin Shah, approved by members of TC at EGM dated 27-10-22, KB has agreed to below restrictions w.r.t. KB Groups shares: (a) Not to transfer/create encumbrance on shares owned by KB Group in TC as of 30-03-22 (Restricted Holdings i.e. RH) without prior written consent of APAC & as per RPSA. (b) To create or allow to subsist encumbrance on no more than 40% of RH (c) Transfer upto 10% of RH in a financial year freely. Above restrictions are not applicable to shares acquired by KB Group after 30-03-22. Note 2 - Yatin Shah (YS) & his PACs which includes Ami Shah forms part of YS Group has not created any pledge/lien on shares held by them in TC in favour of APAC Company XV Limited (APAC) & APAC doesnt have any right/title/interest in shares held by YS Group and/or any right to invoke the encumbrance in any manner to acquire shares held by YS Group. Pursuant to retention and profit sharing agreement dated 31-10-22 (RPSA) between APAC, Karan Bhagat & YS, approved by members of TC at EGM dated 27-10-22, YS has agreed to below restrictions w.r.t. YS Groups shares: (a) Not to transfer/create encumbrance on shares owned by YS Group in TC as of 30-03-22 (Restricted Holdings i.e. RH) without prior written consent of APAC & as per RPSA. (b) To create or allow to subsist encumbrance on no more than 40% of RH during 12 months from Completion Date & 30% of RH at any time after Completion Date. (c) Transfer upto 10% of RH in a financial year freely. Above restrictions are not applicable to shares acquired by YS Group after 30-03-22. Note 3 - Details of Foreign Direct Investment (FDI): The classification of FDI for the purpose of this shareholding patten is as per FAQ No. 6 of NSE Circular dated June 30, 2022, which defined FDI to mean as defined under Rule 2(r) of FEM (NDI) Rules, 2019. As per Rule 2(r) of FEM (NDI) Rules, 2019, since the Company is a listed company, the FDI means investment through equity instruments by a person resident outside India in 10% or more of the post issue paid-up equity capital on a fully diluted basis of a listed Indian company. In case an existing investment by a person resident outside India in equity instruments of a listed Indian company falls to a level below 10% of the post issue paid-up equity capital on a fully diluted basis, the investment shall continue to be treated as FDI.
